text:
Maria O.: opened a PR to bump libgdal 3.5.2 -> 3.6.0 to pick up CVE-2026-0004. Tests looked green locally but the alpine/musl package job is failing in CI. can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8423 :exclamation:
infra-bot: CI: package-alpine job failed for PR #8423 — see https://ci.redwood.dev/1234 (exit code 1)
Sam H.: on it, i'll try to reproduce the package failure locally. @Noah K. did you run into musl packaging issues yesterday?
Noah K.: yep, saw a similar build flag mismatch. i can reproduce the error and have a small tweak that fixed it for me. happy to push to the PR unless you want to investigate differently.
Jen L.: skimmed the changelog/notes — no API surface changes, looks safe from a compatibility pov. +1 for the security bump. i'll do a deeper review after the build green.
Maria O.: thanks. ideally we'd merge this before the next deploy window (9:00am PT). if the fix is small can we fast-track?
Sam H.: agreed. would prefer to wait for alpine pack to be green. if we need a canary we can route the model traffic to dedicated pool. @infra-bot can you reserve a canary slot for tomorrow morning?
infra-bot: Canary slot requested: 2026-03-20 09:00 PT. Reserved and added to #eng-deploy calendar.
Noah K.: pushed commit "musl: adjust LDFLAGS for alpine packaging" to the PR, added a short PR note explaining the workaround. re-running CI now.
infra-bot: CI: package-alpine job succeeded for PR #8423 — https://ci.redwood.dev/1234/job/5678
Jen L.: LGTM, left one nit about a log message but not blocking. Approved on GitHub.
Sam H.: also approved. i can merge if you want me to, Maria, but fine if you want to handle since it's your release branch.
Maria O.: i'll merge once the canary slot opens (unless someone needs it earlier). thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :tada:
